bien_sci_id_coherent.name: bien_sci_id_coherent
bien_sci_id_coherent.value: ("bien"."proprietaire_type" = 'sci' AND "bien"."sci_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bien"."nom_proprietaire" IS NULL) OR ("bien"."proprietaire_type" = 'personne_physique' AND "bien"."sci_id" IS NULL AND "bien"."nom_proprietaire" IS NOT NULL)
